message.content: In the race for California's 10th Congressional District, Mark DeSaulnier sponsors the Block the Bombs Act and voted yes on the Massie amendment eliminating $3.3 billion in military aid to Israel on July 15, 2026, then voted no on subsequent appropriations packages carrying that aid and on the 2027 NDAA linking U.S. and Israeli military systems. In July 2025 he stated he no longer votes for offensive military aid to Israel. He has not called the war in Gaza a genocide. He did vote yes on a 2024 spending bill cutting UNRWA funding and on a 2024 resolution banning PLO members from entering the United States, actions against the pro-Palestinian direction of his later votes. CAIR Action endorsed him for the general and Vote for Peace rates him an Ally; he also holds endorsements from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club and JStreetPAC, which supports U.S.-Israel security aid alongside Palestinian rights and is not equivalent to AIPAC. No other candidate in this race has a researched record.
